correctStatements.text: At 03:25 Agnieszka was paged because 30 percent of EU compute nodes in zone b were unreachable.
At 03:29 Ravi saw the cloud status page report a power event in that zone that began at 03:20 local time.
Solveig reported the EU API error rate at 9 percent and EU batch jobs stalled.
At 03:36 Tobias decided to shift EU traffic weight away from zone b to zones a and c.
At 03:42 Tobias applied the traffic shift, setting the zone b weight to zero.
At 03:50 Solveig saw the error rate fall to 1.2 percent.
Ravi observed zone c running at 85 percent CPU because there was no headroom for losing a zone.
At 04:10 Agnieszka scaled the zone a and c node pools up by 25 percent.
At 04:55 Ravi learned the provider had restored power in zone b and the nodes were returning.
At 05:20 Tobias restored the zone b weight to its normal level and ended the incident.
Ravi will size each zone so it can absorb a one-zone failure.
Tobias will schedule a game day to rehearse the traffic shift.
Agnieszka will document the traffic shift runbook steps.
Solveig summarised that a provider power event took out one EU zone and manual traffic shifting limited customer impact to about 25 minutes of elevated errors.
